Jack up the front end of your car, first one side and then the other.

Take your tire with both hands and see if it shakes when you try to shake it from side to side. Then, try the same thing with shaking it from the top and bottom. Really use some force. Listen for noises.

If it just makes noise, it's bushings. If it moves laterally, it's tie rod, probably the ends but there's an inner connection as well. If it moves perpendicular to the ground, it's wheel bearings.

When you're done replacing those, and do both sides, put new tires on and get an alignment.
